title: Xpert MTB/XDR as follow-on WRD
dek: After RR is found, Xpert XDR interrogates INH, FQ, AMK, KAN, CAP, and ETH loci — not BDQ, LZD, or Pa. It is a bridge to tNGS/WGS, not a 2021-XDR definition machine.
story: WHO’s diagnostic algorithm after an RR result is not “wait six weeks for MGIT.” A follow-on molecular WRD should look at isoniazid and fluoroquinolones at minimum. Xpert MTB/XDR (and similar LPAs) interrogates katG/inhA, gyrA/B QRDR, rrs/eis for injectables, and inhA/ethA-adjacent ETH markers — in a cartridge, from sputum or from a positive Xpert leftover in some workflows.
It does not interrogate atpE, rv0678, rplC, rrl, ddn, or fbi genes. A “negative Xpert XDR” is not XDR-TB ruled out in the 2021 sense. It is INH/FQ/injectable/ETH information.
Use it to decide BPaLM versus BPaL (FQ) and to know whether INH is already lost. Then sequence for Group A extras. Targeted NGS panels overlap this cartridge and go further.
deep: Uncommon katG loss-of-function outside codon 315 will look INH-S on the cartridge and INH-R in MGIT.
Disputed gyrA alleles and heteroresistance below probe mixture thresholds are the usual fights.
Kanamycin/capreomycin probes are historical Group C chemistry. They do not define 2021-XDR.
Trace Ultra specimens may not have enough DNA for XDR follow-on. Culture or tNGS from a better specimen is the adult move.

visual.caption: Xpert XDR’s locus coverage versus 2021 XDR. FQ is on the cartridge and on the definition. BDQ and LZD are on the definition and not on the cartridge.

example.title: Xpert XDR FQ-S, later WGS D94G mixed
example.setup: RR on Ultra, Xpert XDR FQ-S, BPaLM started. Week-3 WGS shows gyrA D94G at 15% AF.

steps.title: Drop M
steps.body: You now have pre-XDR chemistry. BPaL, not BPaLM.

steps.title: Do not call 2021-XDR yet
steps.body: Need BDQ or LZD resistance for that word.

example.takeaway: Xpert XDR is a fast FQ/INH window, not a Group A census.

check.prompt: Xpert MTB/XDR interrogates BDQ and LZD loci:
choices: Yes, that is why it is named XDR
No — name is historical; BDQ/LZD need tNGS/WGS/pDST
check.answer: No — name is historical; BDQ/LZD need tNGS/WGS/pDST
check.why: The cartridge predates treating BDQ/LZD as the XDR step.

check.prompt: The main regimen fork Xpert XDR is built to flip after RR is:
choices: Keep moxifloxacin (BPaLM) versus drop it (BPaL) based on FQ loci
check.answer: Keep moxifloxacin (BPaLM) versus drop it (BPaL) based on FQ loci
check.why: FQ is the pre-XDR step and the M in BPaLM.

check.prompt: On the mutation grid, which pair is marked “not on Xpert XDR”?
choices: atpE/rv0678 and BDQ plus rplC/rrl and LZD
check.answer: atpE/rv0678 and BDQ plus rplC/rrl and LZD
check.why: Those rows are the teaching gap.
